verdict.rationale: Box documents a built-in Box AI that can answer questions about files, summarize, extract metadata and generate content within Box, with configurable AI agents. Most of this evidence is API-focused, and true task delegation (multi-step actions carried out by the assistant) is not shown. missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant UI that performs delegated multi-step tasks, documentation of the agent's action scope beyond Q&A/summarize/extract/generate, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use the Box AI API to ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize files stored in Box.
Summarize, extract, generate, and query content with enterprise permissions intact.
Access, share, edit, and co-create content with AI while accelerating productivity.
Index curated content in a Box Hub and get answers with Box AI.
Configure Box AI API agents with a visual configurator.
